title: The 5/8 theorem
abstract: Proves Gustafson's 5/8 theorem — the Mathlib commuting probability of a nonabelian group is at most 5/8, with the infinite case immediate from commProb being zero — via the finite-group index bounds for the center and centralizers of noncentral elements.

informal.FiveEighths.commProb_le_five_eighths: The commuting probability of a nonabelian group is at most 5/8.
informal.FiveEighths.centralFraction_le_quarter: The center of a finite nonabelian group contains at most a quarter of its elements.
informal.FiveEighths.centralizerFraction_le_half: The centralizer of a noncentral element of a finite group contains at most half of its elements.
